nodes.title: Simulate-hypothesis response drifts from the verdict vocabulary and omits evidence-snapshot fields
nodes.summary: The single corrective task that derives SimulateHypothesisResponseDto's verdict literals from the shared VERDICTS vocabulary and widens evidenceSchema to state the evidence item's own snapshotted semantics.
